blocks.x: Fortieth: Shaykh Ibn Fahad has reported Imam al-Sadiq (‘a) as saying, “Any supplication that is not commenced with a statement of glorification of the Lord is imperfect. Glorification may always precedes praise.”
The reporter asked the Imam (‘a), “What is the least acceptable statement of glorification?”
The Imam (‘a) taught him to say this supplicatory prayer:

اَللّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الاَ وَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْئٌ وَ اَنْتَ الْا خِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْئٌ وَ اَنْتَ الظّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْئٌ وَ اَنْتَ الْباطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْئٌ وَ اَنْتَ الْعَزيزُ الْحَكيمُ
